label: Bayesian Rationalism (LessWrong tradition)
summary: The rationalist movement seeded by Eliezer Yudkowsky's Sequences on LessWrong: human reason is systematically biased firmware to be debugged with probability theory, decision theory, and cognitive-bias research; ideal epistemology is Bayesian updating toward accurate world-models. Entangled with effective altruism and AI-alignment research.

sources.title: Rationality: From AI to Zombies (The Sequences)

variants: Doomers (Yudkowsky/MIRI, high p(doom)) vs accelerationist-adjacent optimists vs mainstream effective-altruist 'worried but working on it'; post-rationalists split off rejecting the movement's legibility bias. Sharpest documented contrast with deep optimism: probabilistic justification of beliefs vs conjecture-and-criticism, and AI-risk pessimism vs education-not-alignment.

positions.summary: Quantified justification-in-degrees: beliefs are probabilities updated by evidence via Bayes' theorem, with priors and calibration — the justificationist pole as Deutsch defines it, though fallibilist in mood.
Transhumanist confidence in what technology and intelligence could achieve, tempered by bias-driven human epistemic limits.
Reason and evidence only; hostile to tradition and faith, wary even of scientific authority when it conflicts with Bayesian reasoning.
The map is not the territory: an objective territory exists and accurate maps of it are the goal, though truth-talk is filtered through probability.
Bifurcated: radical optimism about technological possibility combined with acute pessimism about unaligned superintelligence — 'AGI Ruin' and calls to halt frontier AI.
Selectively precautionary: proactionary about most technology, sharply precautionary about existential risks via expected-value reasoning over catastrophic tails.
High individual epistemic agency ('heroic responsibility') within a deterministic physical universe; compatibilism is standard.
Humanity's 'cosmic endowment' matters enormously — safeguarding the long-term future is the central project.
Mostly anti-realist meta-ethics with strongly held quasi-utilitarian first-order ethics; value is complex, fragile, and human-originated.
Strict naturalism and physicalism; reductionism; many-worlds quantum mechanics favored; minds are computation.
Anti-traditional and reform-minded about institutions and epistemics, though wary of changes that touch existential risk.
Nature is material to be understood and optimized; no intrinsic normative authority in the wild.
Self-authored meaning: fun theory, human flourishing, and protecting humanity's long-term potential.
Individualist-leaning epistemics with strong community coordination norms around shared projects.
